sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: There were no methodological updates to road-vehicle conversion-factor calculation in 2026.
Passenger-car average factors combine UK new-vehicle regulatory emissions data with an uplift for real-world driving.
The regulatory procedure transitioned from NEDC to WLTP.
WLTP is intended to make regulatory results closer to real-world performance than the prior NEDC cycle.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve purpose without claiming exact equivalence.

facts.source_fact: EU light-duty vehicles registered from 2020 have WLTP-based regulatory CO2 values used in the factor calculation.
Petrol and diesel factors are differentiated by vehicle engine-size categories.
A biofuel-content adjustment is applied to passenger-car factors.
CH4 and N2O passenger-car factors draw on UK GHGI emission factors and are aligned with AR5 GWP values.
The 2026 road-factor changes mainly reflect updated data rather than a major methodological change.
facts.expected_handling: Distinguish data refresh from method change.

facts.source_fact: These factors are activity-based company-reporting tools and require distance or other relevant activity data to calculate emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer emissions without activity data.
